name: Metal Dollar
oneLiner: XMD is Metallicus's basket-backed dollar token on XPR Network, reserved by USDC, PYUSD, and Paxos-dollar stablecoins managed by the issuer.
collateral: Reserve basket of dollar stablecoins used by Metal Dollar, including USDC, PYUSD, and Paxos-dollar components such as USDP / XPAX
pegMechanism: Basket-backed stablecoin index on XPR Network, with mint and redeem flows intended to keep XMD near one U.S. dollar against the underlying stablecoin basket

applicabilityBasis.summary: XMD is a U.S.-linked stablecoin index redeemable against a basket of reserve-backed dollar stablecoins rather than a standalone fiat-reserve issuance.

genius.notes: XMD is stablecoin-adjacent and payment-oriented, but its basket-index structure makes GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved. Metallicus published educational GENIUS Act content (metaldollar.com, Mar 2026) and operates a credit-union stablecoin sandbox pilot, but no token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application was found. No GENIUS enforcement action found. Quarterly company reports exist but no monthly reserve attestation.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for XMD. Metallicus shows GENIUS awareness but no public authorization posture.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: XMD runs on an unsupported non-EVM network and is backed by freezable centralized stablecoins; available Pharos sources do not prove a direct holder blacklist path on the XMD token itself.

notices.title: XPR Network contract gap
notices.message: CoinGecko resolves XMD on XPR Network, which is not currently a Pharos-supported chain. Runtime coverage uses CoinGecko price and market cap, while contract-level coverage is intentionally skipped.

mintAuthority.summary: XMD is minted/redeemed 1:1 by users depositing whitelisted reserve stablecoins (USDC/PYUSD/XPAX) into Metallicus's smart-contract treasury on XPR Network; Metal DAO (MTL) governs which stablecoins enter the basket and their weights, so the mint is user-funded but the eligible-collateral set is governance-controlled.

controls.label: Metal DAO (MTL) basket governance
controls.evidence: Metal DAO (MTL governance token) votes on which stablecoins are eligible for the XMD reserve basket and their weightings; it does not mint XMD directly but bounds the whitelist of reserve assets against which users mint/redeem 1:1.

controls.label: XMD treasury mint/redeem contract
controls.evidence: The smart-contract-managed treasury mints XMD when users deposit basket stablecoins (USDC/PYUSD/XPAX) and burns/redeems on the reverse; supply tracks user deposits 1:1 rather than discretionary issuer minting.

review.evidence: Metallicus/XPR Network docs and coverage describe XMD as a reserve-backed stablecoin index treasury: users mint/redeem 1:1 against a basket of fiat-backed stablecoins (USDC, PYUSD, and XPAX), while Metal DAO (MTL) governs basket composition and weights. This is a user-collateralized mint bounded by a governance-controlled collateral whitelist. XMD runs on non-EVM XPR Network, so the on-chain admin/owner of the treasury was not independently read.

sources.label: How do I mint Metal Dollar (XMD)?

unresolvedQuestions: XPR Network is not EVM-compatible and lacks a supported public RPC or Blockscout instance; the XMD treasury contract admin/owner and any Metallicus unilateral mint authority cannot be read via standard keyless tooling. Resolution requires XPR Network-native API access or direct issuer disclosure.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XMD is issued and redeemed against a managed basket of fiat-backed dollar stablecoins.
